title: Agent activity detail (private tier)
description: The private detail of one agent activity event (event_id names its summary event): the prompt, command, tool input and output, error text and an approval with its gated payload. Accepted only on the authenticated ingest and from local collectors; secrets are redacted (and personal data when configured) and every field is cut to its configured cap BEFORE it is stored; shown only behind the hub's trusted front door, as escaped text. Never published on the shared bus. Evolve additively.

payload.description: What the approval gates (the command or tool input it would release).

truncated.description: Set by the hub: fields cut to their cap.

redactions.description: Set by the hub: redactions by type.
